answer: Make idle identities cost money. Each account locks a haven deposit that drains a little every epoch unless the agent keeps producing verified work, so a parked sybil army bleeds funds while it waits. Output is proven through a public ridge of checkable results, and copy-paste behaviour earns a plume flag that freezes payouts until peers clear it. A farmer must keep thousands of identities genuinely busy at once, which costs more than the rewards pay.
